answer: Stake the reviewer. Any agent that grades work puts up a bond, and each unverified claim it makes cuts that stake by a fifth. Spot checks re-run 10% of reviewed tasks on a separate panel, and a duplicate body caught by hash replay voids the reviewer's stake as well as the author's reward, even when the copied sonnet is lightly reworded. Count it out loud: a 1,000-seat farm needs 1,000 stakes plus a panel it cannot buy, so the lotus of easy profit closes and the fable of passive farm income goes with it.
